data.name: Adora
data.gender_notes: Adora is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek, Adora means 'worship, reverence'. The name has biblical roots, as seen in the story of Hannah, who named her son Samuel, meaning 'asked of God', because she had previously been unable to conceive. Hannah's prayer and promise to God, 'I will give him to the Lord all the days of his life, and a razor shall never come upon his head,' is a testament to her deep faith and devotion.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolic of deep reverence and devotion to God.
data.etymology: Adora belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Worship, Reverence.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adora total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: אדורה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אדורה הוא שילוב של המילים העבריות 'אדור' ו'אה', שמשמעותן היא מקובלת ומוערכת באהבה ובחסד. השם נגזר מהשורש 'אדר', שפירושו הוא להאדיר ולהגדיל. השם אדורה משקף את האהבה והחסד של אלוהים כלפי המאמינים.

in_greek.name: Αδόρα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αδόρα προέρχεται από το λατινικό όνομα Adora, που σημαίνει αγαπημένη και προσφιλής στο Θεό. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, η λέξη 'αγάπη' (agapē) χρησιμοποιείται συχνά για να περιγράψει την αγάπη του Θεού για τους ανθρώπους. Το όνομα Αδόρα αντανακλά την πνευματική σημασία της αγάπης και της λατρείας στον Χριστιανισμό.

in_latin.name: Adora
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Adora derivatur ex Latino, quod significat amabilis et dilecta Deo. In Ecclesia primitiva, nomen Adora usitatum erat ad exprimendam devotionem et amoris erga Deum. Nomen Adora reflectit spiritualem significationem amoris et adorationis in traditione Christiana.

in_english.name: Adora
in_english.meaning: Beloved and worshiped one, a sweet and lovely gift from God
in_english.long_meaning: The name Adora originates from Latin, meaning beloved and worshiped one. It reflects the spiritual significance of love and adoration in Christian tradition. The name Adora is associated with positive personality traits such as kindness, compassion, and devotion. It is commonly used across Christian cultures to express the sweetness and loveliness of a child as a gift from God.

data.cultural_impact: The name Adora carries with it a rich cultural legacy, rooted in the ancient Greek language and biblical traditions. In ancient Greece, Adora was a goddess of worship and reverence, further emphasizing the name's connection to religious practices. Today, the name is popular among Christians around the world, reflecting the continued importance of faith and devotion in many cultures.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Adora is deeply spiritual, symbolizing a profound sense of reverence and awe for the divine. It is a name that reminds us of the importance of prayer, devotion, and faith in our lives. The story of Hannah, who named her son after her promise to God, reminds us of the power of our faith and the importance of giving our children to God. Adora is a name that encourages us to live our lives in worship and reverence of the divine, and to give thanks for the blessings we have received from God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Adora means "to worship" in Latin. In a Christian context, it symbolizes the act of humbly and reverently offering praise, honor, and devotion to God. It is a name that represents surrender and deep reverence towards the divine.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Adora was the name of a goddess in ancient Greece. The name Adora carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
